Confirming the execution authority and our preferred sequence. Key items from Legal:

I uploaded a compact execution matrix (Execution_Matrix_FinCo.xlsx) that maps roles -> emails -> fallback. Please populate the fallback contact for FinCo signatory in column D before sending.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts | Redwood Inference

Hi DocuSign Support / Aditya —

- Sender: vanessa@redwood.com (account alias: Vanessa Ortiz / Redwood Inference)
- Routing: Sequential: 1) Claire Benson (FinCo signatory) -> 2) Michael Grant (Redwood countersign)
- Fallback: if Michael unavailable, route to Rishi Malhotra for countersign (Rishi will accept if Michael delegates).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Hi Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the detailed spec. Confirmations below:

- Sender: OK to send from vanessa@redwood.com. When you create the envelope via the web UI or API, set "From Display Name" to "Vanessa Ortiz / Redwood Inference".
- Routing: Sequential routing supported and we set the role order exactly as requested (1: FinCo signatory, 2: Redwood countersign). Fallback routing requires manual step: if Michael is unavailable, Rishi must be added as a signer or Admin can reassign role before envelope completion. We can script an automatic reassignment via the API (we include a sample request).
- Required fields: signature, name, date — supported. Checkbox fields can be required with custom label (we recommend: "I confirm I reviewed Section 6: Data Transfers & Subprocessors").
- Notifications: Certificate-of-completion will be attached to the envelope; add procurement@finco.com and legal@redwood.com as carbon-copy (CC) recipients so they receive the final PDF automatically.
- Evidence & retention: DocuSign includes IP addresses, timestamps, and the audit trail in the Certificate of Completion (CoC). For long-term retention we recommend downloading the CoC and storing it in your records; alternatively you can enable "archival retention" via our Enterprise settings. We attached an API snippet to set retention to 7 years and to download the CoC automatically to an S3 bucket.

Next steps: Aditya to stage a test envelope in production-mode with the exact fields; Laura to confirm checkboxes language. Once confirmed we can publish the envelope template and Vanessa can send the live envelope.

Regards,
DocuSign Support
